# RhineLabUI scene attribution

Source: https://github.com/LBEILC/RhineLabUI
Commit: d9ecb6c6f7a36e8b522072a0ebbd7691a50550a7
License: MIT, retained alongside these files and in public/licenses/RhineLabUI-MIT.txt.

The real ArchiveScene, long-lens framing, cassette models, lighting, frosted glass, selection/extraction, depth of field and pointer/drag behavior are reused. Local changes replace labels and sample archive metadata with childcare themes, add book and letter-block meshes to the selected cassette, fix disposal during asynchronous loading, and adapt asset paths. The React host excludes all original audio, archive documents and application code.
